title: 2026 September TikTok Shop API Updates Summary
content:
## Summary Below is a summary of TikTok Shop Open API updates for **September 2026**. Three of these updates are **Breaking Changes**: the removal of two buyer-fault cancellation reasons from the Cancel Order API, the Shipping Template widget sunset (both effective **October 31**), and the retirement of the single-video Analytics details API (no later than **December 28**). New category attribute and compliance requirements also take effect in the UK, EU, US, and Malaysia **from late September**. Please assess the impact first, then complete the required migrations and field updates by each market's effective date. This document uses two severity markers. 🔴 **[Breaking]** means your integration stops working unless you migrate. ⚠️ **[Action Required]** means the API stays compatible, but products, orders, labels, or events can fail if you do not adapt. For the full record, see the Changelog linked at the end of this document. ## 1. Breaking Changes and Key Updates | Update | Required Actions | Key Date | | --- | --- | --- | | ⚠️ **[Action Required] Webhook Egress IP Update**
Webhook traffic from the **SG** and **EU** egress regions now comes from new IP ranges as well. US egress IPs are unchanged, and all previously published IPs remain valid. Payloads, event types, headers, signature verification, and retry behavior are unchanged. If your endpoint filters by source IP and you do nothing, your own firewall drops events from the new ranges, so you **miss events with no error returned**. | · If you allowlist source IPs, add every published range to your firewall, WAF, security group, load balancer, API gateway, and reverse proxy rules. Add CIDR blocks as CIDR, not as single addresses.
· Allowlist every region you serve.
· After the update, check that events are arriving and review firewall drop logs.
· Use signature verification as the main authenticity check, with IP allowlisting as an extra layer. | **Update allowlists now** (see the notice for the latest effective date) | | ⚠️ **[Action Required] US Combined Listing: Merge into Variants**
Sellers can merge separately listed products of the same style into one main product detail page. Merged child products get **new SKU IDs** under the main product. Their original child SKU IDs are returned through the existing virtual bundle structure: `data.skus[].combined_skus[].sku_id` in Get Product, and `line_items[].combined_listing_skus[].sku_id` in Get Order Detail. | · Use Get Product to keep main-to-child SKU mappings in sync.
· For fulfillment, read `combined_listing_skus` (`product_id`, `sku_id`, `seller_sku`, `sku_count`) in Get Order Detail.
· **If your integration uses only the order line's**`sku_id`**to find the original child SKU, you need to adapt it.**
· Price and inventory sync from the original child SKUs. Update those child products, not the main listing. | **Live** for US sellers with the feature enabled | | ⚠️ **[Action Required] UK & EU Dangerous Goods (DG) Compliance Attributes**
For selected UK and EU categories, Get Attributes returns DG attributes as mandatory. Depending on the category, these include battery type and characteristics, packaging method, rechargeable status, aerosol and flammable liquid volume, SDS / UN38.3 documentation, and hazardous material classification. New listings without these values cannot be published. | · Read the DG attributes that Get Attributes returns for each category, and show them as mandatory in your listing flows.
· Collect and validate the values before submission.
· Pass DG values every time an affected listing is created or edited.
· Applies to local and cross-border sellers in the affected categories. | **Mandatory from September 22, 2026** | | ⚠️ **[Action Required] US Category Attribute Updates: Auto Parts, Tires, Motorcycles, and Engine Oils**
Adds vehicle fitment, specification, and compliance attributes, such as year / make / model / engine, MPN, OEM part number, EPA numbers, and CARB compliance status. All 10 tire categories get mandatory attributes, including Installation Recommendation, For Highway Use, Tire Class, size / load / speed specifications, Tire Identification Number, EPA establishment / registration numbers (`102692` / `102694`), and CARB Compliance (`102697`). UTQG ratings are added to Passenger Car, Motorbike, and Lorry & SUV. | · Once the update takes effect, call Get Attributes for each affected leaf category, then refresh cached attributes and value mappings.
· Submit values through `product_attributes`, following the mandatory and conditional rules the API returns.
· Check listing flows for missing mandatory attributes, predefined values, and custom input. | **Planned for September 30, 2026** | | ⚠️ **[Action Required] Malaysia: Key Attributes Become Mandatory for Selected Hi-Po Categories**
Selected attributes change from optional to required in Health (15 L3 categories, 4 attributes), Sports & Outdoor (4 L3 categories, 4 attributes), and Tools & Hardware (40 L3 categories, Warranty Duration / Warranty Type). A new structured attribute, **Energy Efficiency Star Rating**, is required for 8 Large Home Appliances L3 categories. | · Review MY product creation and update flows for the affected categories.
· Fill in every newly required attribute before submission.
· Add support for Energy Efficiency Star Rating.
· This is a category configuration rollout. There is no new API version. | **Effective September 30, 2026** | | ⚠️ **[Action Required] US Shop Performance Score (SPS) Update**
The new SPS replaces the existing page in Seller Center, with revised Product Satisfaction and Logistics & Fulfillment metrics. Customer Service is unchanged. Existing SPS APIs stay available, but their scores and scoring rules become **reference only**. New SPS APIs will be announced separately. | · If you still display data from existing SPS APIs, label it "Previous SPS version — for reference only".
· Review alerts and recommendations built on the previous scoring rules.
· Send sellers to Seller Center for current scores and improvement guidance. | **October 15, 2026** | | 🔴 **[Breaking] Cancel Order API: Two Buyer-Fault Cancellation Reasons Removed**
In Cancel Order (`POST /return_refund/202602/cancellations`), the `cancel_reason` values `seller_cancel_paid_reason_address_not_deliver` and `seller_cancel_paid_reason_buyer_requested_cancellation` will be rejected. This matches Seller Center behavior. `seller_cancel_reason_unable_to_fulfill_order` is available as the alternative. Applies to standard and auction orders, for local and cross-border sellers. | · Remove both reasons from every cancellation reason picker, mapping table, default, and fallback.
· Re-map affected cases to `out_of_stock`, `wrong_price`, or `unable_to_fulfill_order`.
· When you get `25001020` / `25001015` / `25001014`, ask the seller to pick another reason. Do not retry the same payload.
· Make the same change if you still call earlier Cancel Order versions. | **October 31, 2026** | | 🔴 **[Breaking] Shipping Template Widget Sunset**
The 2024 legacy Shipping template widget in Partner Center is being retired, and any slot that still embeds it will fail to load. There is **no replacement widget or API**. Shipping template configuration moves entirely to Seller Center. Other widgets, including Shipping by TikTok, are not affected, and no re-authorization is needed. | · List every place in your app that embeds the widget.
· Replace each one with a redirect to the Seller Center shipping template page.
· Update onboarding and help copy. Ask sellers to review any templates they created through the widget.
· Release the updated app version before the sunset date. | **October 31, 2026** | | ⚠️ **[Action Required] GS POP Sellers Shipping to the EU: Product Identifier (PID) Requirement**
Goods shipped from outside the EU directly to EU consumers need a valid PID for customs declaration. The platform provides the M-PID. Sellers must provide **at least one** of Seller SKU (NS-PID) or Product Identifier (S-PID, such as GTIN / EAN / UPC / JAN / ISBN). | · Make sure at least one of Seller SKU or Product Identifier has a valid value.
· NS-PID format: letters and numbers only, 6–50 characters, with no spaces or special characters.
· New products must follow the rule from September 1. Fix existing products before the end of October.
· Update validation and sync logic in listing tools and ERP integrations. | **New products: from September 1, 2026**
**Existing products: by end of October 2026**
**Customs enforcement: November 1, 2026** | | ⚠️ **[Action Required] US Wig Material Becomes Mandatory, with Conditional Certification**
The Wig material attribute (`102428`) becomes mandatory for 15 US wig categories. "Human hair" requires the human hair percentage attribute. "100% human hair" requires a human hair content test report submitted through `certifications`. "Synthetic hair" requires nothing extra under this rule. | · Refresh Get Attributes (`requirement_conditions`) and Get Category Rules (`product_certifications`).
· Make Wig material a mandatory single-select field in your listing forms.
· Upload the report with Upload Product File or Upload Product Image, then pass the result in `certifications`.
· Do not set a material value without the seller's confirmation. Test with Check Product Listing. | **Rollout started September 21, 2026. API enforcement starts November 21, 2026** | | 🔴 **[Breaking] Analytics: Single-Video Details API Retirement**
Get Shop Videos Performance Details (`GET /analytics/202609/shop_videos/batch_performance`) replaces Get Shop Video Performance Details (`GET /analytics/202509/shop_videos/{video_id}/performance`). The 202609 versions of Shop Performance, Video Overview, LIVE Overview, and LIVE List also remove fields and change response structures. See section 2.1. | · Move single-video calls to the batch API and handle errors for each video separately.
· When you upgrade to 202609, map fields by metric definition, not by field name.
· Query product-level details through Get Shop Video Product Performance List. | **Old API retired no later than December 28, 2026** | ## 2. Featured New Capabilities ( Recommended) This month the platform introduced three capability sets: **deeper shop, video, and LIVE analytics**, **real-time inventory change notifications**, and **LIVE auction support across product, promotion, and content APIs**. They help partners replace inferred or manual work with reliable, programmable data flows. We recommend reviewing them first. ### 2.1 Analytics API Upgrade: 8 APIs Enhanced, Including a New Batch Video Details API Analytics API coverage expands across shop sales and channel attribution, video sales and engagement, and LIVE sales and viewing performance. * **Shop sales and channel attribution**: `Get Shop Performance` (202609) adds GMV breakdowns by LIVE, video, and product card, and by seller and creator content, Shop Tab, and search. It also adds average order value, paying customers, cancellations and returns, shipping fees, taxes, and product impressions and clicks. * **Hourly tracking**: `Get Shop Performance Per Hour` (202510) adds order, customer, content-attributed GMV, and product traffic metrics to both hourly data and daily totals. * **Video performance**: `Get Shop Video Performance Overview` (202609) adds video-attributed GMV, conversion, views, and GPM, plus a new `today` flag for real-time data. `Get Shop Video Performance List` (202605) adds attributed GMV, engagement, video-to-LIVE clicks, completion rate, and creator information. * **Batch video details (new)**: `Get Shop Videos Performance Details` (202609) queries up to **500**`video_ids` in one call. It returns sales, engagement, audience profiles, and video metadata, with errors reported per video. * **Video product efficiency**: `Get Shop Video Product Performance List` (202509) adds purchasing customers, product CTR, GMV per 1,000 product impressions, and product impressions and clicks. * **LIVE and auction performance**: `Get Shop LIVE Performance Overview` and `Get Shop LIVE Performance List` (202609) add LIVE- and auction-attributed sales, direct and indirect GMV, viewing and engagement rates, a new `traffic` structure, and the data update time. **Integration notes**: Public by default. Metrics added to existing versions (202510 / 202605 / 202509) are additive. The 202609 versions include field removals and structure changes. For example, `sales.gmv` is flattened to `amount` / `currency`. LIVE `account_type` values change, and the LIVE List requires `account_type`. LIVE `avg_viewing_duration` changes from String to Int64. Map fields by metric definition, not by name. Do not add up GMV metrics that use different attribution definitions. Treat values that exist only in offline data differently from a value of 0. **Recommended for**: Seller development teams and analytics ISVs that build shop, content, or LIVE performance reports. ### 2.2 Inventory Changed by Shop Webhook: Real-Time SKU Inventory Sync The new `Inventory Changed by Shop` webhook (`type: 71`) notifies you whenever a SKU's inventory quantity changes. It covers changes from order creation, cancellation, and shipment, manual Seller Center adjustments, OpenAPI updates, inventory locked or released for campaigns and creator collaborations, and automatic system replenishment. * **Post-change snapshot**: `quantity_snapshot_after_change` returns total, available, committed, and in-shop inventory, plus inventory locked for campaigns and creators. * **Per-change details**: the `change_detail` array returns the trigger source, time, and quantity change for each inventory category. * **Built-in idempotency**: `event_id` deduplicates whole events, and `idempotency_key` deduplicates individual changes. **Integration notes**: Available in all markets. This is a new webhook event, not a new API version, and it is delivered to your configured webhook URL. A snapshot is the inventory after the change, and a delta is an increase or decrease. Never apply both to the same balance. **Recommended for**: ERP, inventory management, and multichannel commerce integrations that need accurate, real-time stock levels. ### 2.3 LIVE Auction Support Across Product, Promotion, and Content APIs Three related updates let partners manage auction products from end to end: * **Product selling format**: Create Product, Edit Product (202309 / 202509), and Check Product Listing accept the optional `selling_format` field: `FIXED_PRICE` (default) or `FIXED_PRICE_AND_LIVE_AUCTION`, which requires a starting bid price. Get Product and Search Products return `selling_format`, including the response-only value `LIVE_AUCTION`. Never send that value back in a request. * **Promotion eligibility**: Create / Update Promotion Activity (202309) accept the optional `auction_support_type` (`ALL` by default, or `EXCLUDE_AUCTION`). Get Activity and Search Promotion Activities return it. Available now in all markets. * **Content restriction**: Post Shoppable Photos and Post Shoppable Video reject products sold by auction only, with error code `170001063`. Ask users to replace the product before retrying. **Integration notes**: All changes are backward compatible. They add only optional request fields, response fields, enum values, and one new validation error. No new permission scope is introduced. **Recommended for**: Listing tools, promotion management apps, and content or LIVE commerce partners that work with auction sellers. ## 3. Other Updates | API Category | Update Summary | Details | | --- | --- | --- | | Fulfillment API | UK & EU: Create Packages supports seller-edited parcel dimensions and weight | Create Packages (`/fulfillment/202512/packages`), previously used only in the US, now supports Shipped by Platform (4PL) label creation in the UK and EU. Pass `line_items[].dimension` (length, width, and height together, in `CM` for EU) and `line_items[].weight` (in `GRAM` for EU). The platform uses the latest values for routing and label purchase. This reduces shipping fee deviations, seller disputes, and carrier chargebacks. The flow is optional: you can pass product-level dimensions directly or add a seller review step before label creation. | | Finance API | 8 new fee and tax properties for Growth Packages and auto-post shoppable video | Get Transactions by Order and Get Transactions by Statement (202501), and Get Unsettled Transactions (202507), add the following.
Under `fee_tax_breakdown.fee`: `new_customer_growth_package_fee`, `store_gmv_growth_package_fee`, `target_product_gmv_growth_package_fee`, `auto_post_shoppable_video_commission_fee`.
Under `fee_tax_breakdown.tax`: `new_customer_growth_package_fee_tax`, `store_gmv_growth_package_fee_sales_tax`, `target_product_gmv_growth_package_tax`, `auto_post_shoppable_video_sales_tax`.
Growth Package fee fields apply in US / JP / EU / UK. Tax fields are filled for the US only and return `"0"` elsewhere. The change is response-only and non-breaking, with no new scope. | | Product API (Opportunity) | Get Opportunity Detail and List Opportunity add tag codes, rewards, and reference product fields | Both APIs add `tag_codes` (`List`, matched one-to-one and in order with `tags`), `external_product_id`, and `reference_source`. The last two are LATAM only, and `reference_source` is returned only when `external_product_id` is present. Get Opportunity Detail also adds `tags`. List Opportunity adds `reward_info` and an optional `tag_codes` request filter, for example `["CORE_PRODUCT", "TOP_PRODUCT"]`. Update your response models, and handle responses where `reference_source` is missing. | ## References * Changelog: [https://partner.tiktokshop.com/docv2/changelog](https://partner.tiktokshop.com/docv2/changelog) * API Documentation: [https://partner.tiktokshop.com/docv2/](https://partner.tiktokshop.com/docv2/) If you have questions about these updates or need support, please [submit a ticket](https://partner.tiktokshop.com/docv2/page/kwfskwpj) to contact us. Thank you.
